summary: Risk-off hangover: Nov 5 spot BTC ETFs saw ~$430M net outflows (Fidelity/BlackRock led) as BTC slid to a ~$75.2k low with heavy liquidations, tracking the Nasdaq dump. Mild offset from White House review of an SEC crypto broker-dealer rule proposal. US payrolls due later today (13:30 UK) are the next swing factor.
catalyst_note: 2026-11-05 spot BTC ETF net outflow ~$430M; Nov 6 US payrolls due
